title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Plan Terms — Entry, Destination Verification and Plan Changes
content:
Cartwise Shopper Payouts offers six payout plans: Weekly Direct Deposit, Instant Cashout, Everyday Pay Card Blue, Everyday Pay Card Gold, Everyday Pay Card Platinum and Everyday Pay Card Diamond. These terms govern who may hold a plan, how a new payout destination is verified, and when the account may move to another plan.

## 1. Entry to a plan

1.1 A plan is open to a shopper whose contractor account (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts) is active and whose shopper level is at least the plan's minimum shopper level on the shopper ladder.

1.2 The shopper ladder ranks upward: Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum, Full-Service Shopper Diamond. "At least" a level means that level or any level above it.

1.3 The plan's minimum shopper level is a figure of the plan itself and is read from the plan's own terms.

## 2. Verification of the destination

2.1 Verification uses the plan's verification method (micro-deposits, a card push test or card activation, as the plan provides) and must complete within the verification window counted from the opening date.

2.2 Counting. The verification window is counted in calendar days with the opening date as day 0, and the last day to verify is the opening date plus the plan's verification window in days, inclusive. Verification on that last day is in time; verification on any later day is not.

2.3 The dates that decide the question are the opening date and the verification date recorded on the payout account itself, for the same payout account.

2.4 Setups still unverified after that last day close with the reason "verification failed".

### Boundary cases (hypothetical window of 10 days, account opened on 1 March)

| Verification date | Day count from opening | In time? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | day 0 | Yes |
| 11 March | day 10 (last day) | Yes |
| 12 March | day 11 | No — a setup still unverified after 11 March closes as verification failed |

## 3. Plan changes

3.1 A plan change is allowed only while the payout account is active, at most the plan's number of plan changes per 30 days, and only to a plan whose minimum shopper level the shopper meets.

3.2 The count of plan changes is the number of the shopper's confirmed plan-change requests on the account whose creation time falls in the rolling 30 calendar days ending at the present moment. Requests that were not confirmed do not count.

3.3 The account status that decides the question is the status on the payout account record: pending verification, frozen and closed accounts do not change plan.

3.4 Card plans on which the card tier follows the shopper level move to the card plan matching the shopper's new level on each level evaluation.

### Points of judgement

| Account status | Confirmed plan changes in the rolling 30 days, compared with the plan's allowance | Target plan's minimum level met? | Plan change allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active | Below the allowance | Yes | Yes |
| Active | Already at the allowance | Yes | No |
| Active | Below the allowance | No | No |
| Frozen, pending verification or closed | Any | Any | No |
